capabilities: Run Quake 1 in a new tab or separate window
Locate, import, and load .pak game data files from the vault
Launch the game from quake code blocks with command-line arguments
Load mission packs and mods via command-line arguments
Store saves, configs, and demos in the vault so they sync with it
extras: README is written in Portuguese. The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only (needs keyboard and mouse); compiled plugin is distributed under GPL v2 because it bundles the WebQuake engine.
problem: Obsidian has no way to run the Quake 1 game engine inside a tab, window, or embedded code block using files kept in the vault.

relations.evidence: O plugin traz o motor do jogo (WebQuake, um port do Quake original para JavaScript/WebGL)
o motor em vendor/webquake/ é derivado do código-fonte do Quake da id Software

requires.name: Quake 1 game data (pak0.pak from a shareware or full copy)

summary: Embedded WebQuake engine that runs Quake 1 in an Obsidian tab or separate window, loading .pak game data files stored in the vault.
